title: 日本ダービーの後に・抜山蓋世

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a win at the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf carves her name next to the greatest Umamusume in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She resolves to claim another crown in the Kikuka Sho, but her packed schedule is starting to take its toll, and Air Groove is only getting more concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As usual, however, it's Symboli Rudolf's way or the highway. Even a grueling race can't keep her from her student council duties.
